mechanism: Establish one original clearly adult operator, a physical input device and a visible response display in the same geography. For every important virtual event, show one specific physical input first, then the corresponding screen or machine response, then a readable operator reaction when appropriate. Escalate from selection through locomotion and defense to one decisive result. Reconnect the result to the same adult rather than ending on the interface alone. The reusable mechanism is input-before-output evidence, device-screen correspondence, escalating task states and human-result closure—not the source woman, arcade, game, characters, cabinet, controls, moves, venue, creator identity or timing.

invariants.rule: Establish one clearly adult operator, physical controls and response display together.
invariants.ablation_failure: Screen-only footage cannot prove who caused the action.

invariants.rule: Show each important physical input before its matching virtual response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Output-first editing makes control correspondence ambiguous.

invariants.rule: Use at least three different input-response pairs rather than repeating one button.
invariants.ablation_failure: A single repeated action provides little mechanism breadth.

invariants.rule: Escalate from setup and navigation to one decisive result state.
invariants.ablation_failure: Disconnected interactions feel like a demo reel.

invariants.rule: End by reconnecting the result to the same adult's readable reaction.
invariants.purpose: Closes machine evidence with human meaning.
invariants.ablation_failure: An interface-only ending loses the operator.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: source adult woman, face, clothes and reactions
source Japanese arcade venue, cabinet and game screen
source game characters, moves, selection and knockout interface
source token, joystick, buttons and exact hand actions
source camera route, Seedance 2.5 wording, creator identity and timing
